summary: Creative Realities filed an 8-K regarding a registered direct offering and pre-funded warrants. On June 29, 2026, it entered an underwriting agreement with Craig-Hallum Capital Group to sell 2,528,571 shares at $3.50 each and pre-funded warrants at $3.49. Net proceeds of ~$10.9M will repay debt and increase revolver availability. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
